description: Static AIP Japan aerodrome/runway master data extracted from the eight supplied airport PDFs. Training-school traffic-pattern geometry is intentionally not included in this AIP layer.

conventions.coordinates: AIP-published latitude/longitude; raw compact DMS and decimal degrees are both retained.
conventions.bearing: Runway geometry uses AIP TRUE BRG. Magnetic variation is stored separately and is not used to construct geometry.
conventions.annual_change_sign: Eastward annual change positive, Westward annual change negative.
conventions.null_semantics: null means not stated in the extracted source field; values are not inferred.

included: AD 2.2 aerodrome geographical and administrative data
RJFT local VFR/traffic-pattern restrictions explicitly stated in the supplied AIP
